body:
Possibly related [Issue Comment](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/79446#issuecomment-1763060932)
as `nvldumdx.dll` also gets loaded every frame when I resize the game window with vsync
> This also affects the editor window.
> 
> System Info:
> 
> Godot v4.2.beta ([a574c02](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/a574c0296b38d5f786f249b12e6251e562c528cc)) - Windows 10.0.22621 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.3598) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 Threads)
>
